irontanks.guide.copper_tank.intro:
More room for the fluids that keep industry moving.

A BuildCraft-compatible tank tier with a capacity of 27 buckets (27,000 mB).

Use tank upgrades to preserve the stored fluid while changing tiers.
irontanks.guide.copper_tank.details:
Operation

Place compatible tanks directly above or below one another to form a vertical fluid column. BuildCraft pipes and machines access the native tank capability.

irontanks.guide.void_tank.intro:
More room for the fluids that keep industry moving.

A compact disposal tank that continuously destroys up to 80 mB of stored fluid per tick.

Use tank upgrades to preserve the stored fluid while changing tiers.
irontanks.guide.void_tank.details:
Operation

It can join compatible tanks vertically. Fluid reaching this tank is deleted; do not use it for valuable fluids.
irontanks.guide.creative_tank.intro:
More room for the fluids that keep industry moving.

A creative-only source tank. Once filled with a fluid, drains provide that fluid without reducing the stored amount.

Use tank upgrades to preserve the stored fluid while changing tiers.
irontanks.guide.creative_tank.details:
Operation

The creative tank intentionally refuses vertical tank connections to prevent ambiguous infinite balancing chains.
irontanks.guide.glass_copper_upgrade.int:
Upgrade the container, not the cleanup job.

Converts a BuildCraft glass tank into a copper tank in place.

Use the upgrade on the matching tank block.
irontanks.guide.glass_copper_upgrade.det:
Fluid preservation

The block is replaced on the server and its complete fluid stack is copied into the new BuildCraft tank before the upgrade item is consumed.
